### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

# Where enterprise AI runs and outcomes scale.

## The trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference
## and agents in production.

From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to
deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that
regulated and mission-critical environments demand.

[ Talk to an Expert ][117] [ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][118]

## Introducing our AI operating framework

Palantir has named Rackspace a preferred partner to deploy and operate Foundry and AIP for
regulated, sovereign and private cloud environments.

[ Read the Press Release ][119] [ Explore the Partnership ][120]
[Rackspace Palantir]
[Enterprise AI Cloud]

## Rackspace is the operator of the full enterprise AI stack.

### One partner. Full accountability.

We assemble, integrate and operate the full stack from governed private cloud to AI inference and
agents in production, and remain accountable for outcomes long after deployment is complete.

#### Curated partners across every layer of the stack.

We have assembled best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack to connect models, platform
and infrastructure into a governed system, purpose-built for enterprise AI in regulated
environments.

#### Governance built in. Not bolted on.

Security, compliance, data sovereignty and uptime are foundational to every enterprise AI cloud we
operate, especially in regulated and high-stakes environments.

#### Forward deployed engineers who build, run and scale

Our engineers embed directly in your environment to build, operationalize and run enterprise AI,
turning use cases into production systems and scaling them over time.

[ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][121]

## Enterprise AI Cloud Partner Ecosystem

We have curated best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack. Our ecosystem is deliberate,
opinionated and selected for how partners integrate across the stack and how they perform within it.
Everything is stitched together and governed as one system, so you can focus on outcomes instead of
managing complexity.

[AMD][VMware by Broadcom][Palantir][UNIPHORE][Rubrik][Dell Technologies]
[Explore our Ecosystem][122]
[Seattle Children's Logo]

> “We partnered with Rackspace because of Fanatical Experience® and their ability to provide an
> infrastructure to a guaranteed uptime of 99.999%, which means that our clinicians would have
> secure access to our EMR around the clock at the point of care.”

Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer,
Seattle Children’s Hospital [ See the case study ][123]

[See more case studies][124]

## 25+ years of experience operating mission-critical infrastructure. We’re built to run what comes
## next.

From infrastructure to enterprise AI in production, our depth shows up in the certification our
engineers hold, the platforms we’re qualified to operated and the environments we’ve kept running
for the industries that trust us with their most critical systems.

2,200+ certified technical experts
10,000+ technical certifications
600+ AI platform certifications
39 data centers globally

## Industry-Recognized Leadership

Independently recognized by the leading analysts who cover enterprise infrastructure and AI.

[Forrester][Gartner][IDC][ISG]

## Ready to operationalize AI?

Let's explore your use cases and build the full-stack foundation for real outcomes.

[ Get Started ][125]

### Testimonials

## Don’t just take our word for it

  CTO of Co-native
* > “Before including Avassa as part of our delivery, we had to manually install, version, and

  > With Avassa, we are able to deliver our product as-a-service and lifecycle manage the
  > distributed software in a centralized, remote, and secure fashion. This helps us significantly
  > reduce overhead and instead focus on creative competitive new features for our customers.”
  
  Ida Rehnström
  COO of Flasheye
* > “Avassa’s industry track record, its focus on the management and observability of workloads at
  > scale and its recognition of the importance of location in the secure placement of edge
  > applications make it stand out in an increasingly crowded edge-native orchestration field”
  
  Caroline Chappell
  **Analysys Mason**
* > “With the Avassa platform, we are able to deploy and operate our applications at the edge with
  > ease, using the same mechanisms we already have in place for centralized cloud delivery. This

  > they have grown to love in the cloud.” 
  
  Shayne Clausson
  CTO of Extenda Retail

## WHY EDGE AI?

## Applications and AI that run where the data is generated

Enterprises expect feature velocity and retraining of models according to expectations set by the
central cloud. Meanwhile, many applications and AI models run much better at the edge. This should
not limit your operational efficiency or speed of innovation. With Avassa, you can leverage
automation and lower your overhead costs related to edge application management in industrial,
retail, or other on-site edge environments.

[Learn more][61]

HOW OUR EDGE COMPUTING PLATFORM WORKS

## Deploy, Update & Operate Edge Applications With Ease
* [1. Set up your hosts and sites][62]
* [2. Register and deploy your first applications][63]
* [3. Checking in on your application][64]

Setting up new sites is a breeze when you bring the Avassa Edge Enforcer agent into play. Imagine a
handy container that takes charge of all the local container runtime on your hosts. It acts like an
agent, handling everything from making sure your containers play nice together to securing data.

Installing the Edge Enforcer is as straightforward as it gets, thanks to its automated and
zero-trust architecture that avoids the hassle of manual and host-specific setups. Once in place,
call home to their Control Tower, and receives all configurations and keys they need to keep data
safe and sound, not just for the site, but for all its users.

The next step is to craft the blueprint of your containerized application in an application
specification. These specifications come in the well-known forms of YAML or JSON, letting you
configure them using exsiting CI/CD tooling, oris for a more hands-on approach, through the Control
Tower’s web interface.

When it’s time to decide where your application should operate, you use application deployment
specifications. This is a comprehensive way to tell the system where (in which sites) a specific
application should operate. With a bit of simple matching language magic, you can specify where and
under what conditions—think location, hardware specs, or how much resources you’ve got
available—your application is placed only where it makes sense and provide value.

Once your applications are deployed, keeping an eye on their health becomes crucial, and sometimes,
you need to dig into the forensics of incidents that may occur. Every container in your deployment
is under constant surveillance by the platform, ensuring everything runs smoothly not just at the
container level but also through optional health checks tailored to your application’s unique needs.
When things go sideways, the system doesn’t just throw alerts at you; it tells you exactly which
container is down which application it’s a part of, and where it’s located. This way, you’re not
just getting a warning; you’re getting a roadmap to the problem.

Diving into observability. With distributed log queries, you can pull up the historical data or
catch the live action from wherever your operations are spread out. You’re not drowning in data;
you’re strategically filtering by time, what’s in the logs, where it happened, and more, so you’re
only ever dealing with information that directly ties back to whatever challenge you’re facing right
now.

[Learn more][65]

## WHAT MAKES AVASSA A LEADING EDGE MANAGEMENT PLATFORM

### Opinionated and user-friendly

We don’t overcomplicate things. With Avassa, it’s easy to remotely deploy applications and AI across
large-scale edge environments in a few clicks.

### Distributed security
### you can trust

We built our platform on zero-trust with a layered security model across sites and tenants, and
eliminated any time-consuming manual work.

### Application-centric operations

Our platform was built with the needs of application operations at the forefront, freeing you from
the massive complexities associated with infrastructure-centric solutions.

## WHY EDGE AI?

## Applications and AI that run where the data is generated

Enterprises expect feature velocity and retraining of models according to expectations set by the
central cloud. Meanwhile, many applications and AI models run much better at the edge. This should
not limit your operational efficiency or speed of innovation. With Avassa, you can leverage
automation and lower your overhead costs related to edge application management in industrial,
retail, or other on-site edge environments.

[Learn more][61]

HOW OUR EDGE COMPUTING PLATFORM WORKS

## Deploy, Update & Operate Edge Applications With Ease
* [1. Set up your hosts and sites][62]
* [2. Register and deploy your first applications][63]
* [3. Checking in on your application][64]

Setting up new sites is a breeze when you bring the Avassa Edge Enforcer agent into play. Imagine a
handy container that takes charge of all the local container runtime on your hosts. It acts like an
agent, handling everything from making sure your containers play nice together to securing data.

Installing the Edge Enforcer is as straightforward as it gets, thanks to its automated and
zero-trust architecture that avoids the hassle of manual and host-specific setups. Once in place,
call home to their Control Tower, and receives all configurations and keys they need to keep data
safe and sound, not just for the site, but for all its users.

The next step is to craft the blueprint of your containerized application in an application
specification. These specifications come in the well-known forms of YAML or JSON, letting you
configure them using exsiting CI/CD tooling, oris for a more hands-on approach, through the Control
Tower’s web interface.

When it’s time to decide where your application should operate, you use application deployment
specifications. This is a comprehensive way to tell the system where (in which sites) a specific
application should operate. With a bit of simple matching language magic, you can specify where and
under what conditions—think location, hardware specs, or how much resources you’ve got
available—your application is placed only where it makes sense and provide value.

Once your applications are deployed, keeping an eye on their health becomes crucial, and sometimes,
you need to dig into the forensics of incidents that may occur. Every container in your deployment
is under constant surveillance by the platform, ensuring everything runs smoothly not just at the
container level but also through optional health checks tailored to your application’s unique needs.
When things go sideways, the system doesn’t just throw alerts at you; it tells you exactly which
container is down which application it’s a part of, and where it’s located. This way, you’re not
just getting a warning; you’re getting a roadmap to the problem.

Diving into observability. With distributed log queries, you can pull up the historical data or
catch the live action from wherever your operations are spread out. You’re not drowning in data;
you’re strategically filtering by time, what’s in the logs, where it happened, and more, so you’re
only ever dealing with information that directly ties back to whatever challenge you’re facing right
now.

[Learn more][65]

## WHAT MAKES AVASSA A LEADING EDGE MANAGEMENT PLATFORM

### Opinionated and user-friendly

We don’t overcomplicate things. With Avassa, it’s easy to remotely deploy applications and AI across
large-scale edge environments in a few clicks.

### Distributed security
### you can trust

We built our platform on zero-trust with a layered security model across sites and tenants, and
eliminated any time-consuming manual work.

### Application-centric operations

Our platform was built with the needs of application operations at the forefront, freeing you from
the massive complexities associated with infrastructure-centric solutions.

# Welcome to Channel Dive

It’s a new day for tech channel news at Industry Dive and Informa TechTarget.

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

## Trusted by Users

4.8 based on 255 [reviews][68]
[Softpedia]
Great way to integrate cloud storage into macOS seamlessly. Accounts can be mounted as regular
drives and accessed directly via Finder. Use multiple cloud storage accounts without them butting
heads, and connect to more than one account from the same provider without issues.
Catalin Chelariu
[AppStore]
CloudMounter has been a game-changer for my Mac workflow. The way it mounts remote storage directly
into Finder with native integration is exactly what I've always wanted - no clutter, no extra apps,
just clean access through the system itself.
MaikelMansi
[PCWorld]
I loved CloudMounter’s super-clean interface. I could get picky about a couple of things as with the
competition, but I’ll let them go because of the overall excellence. CloudMounter features the
cleanest interface of any of the utilities. That said, I’d like a bit more in the way of visible
options such as S3-compatible. These are connected using the AWS S3 icon.
Jon Jacobi
[SFTP to Go]
CloudMounter lets you mount cloud and SFTP servers as local drives on macOS and Windows, simplifying
your workflow. It delivers exactly what it promises: quick cloud and remote server access without
the baggage of slow syncing, redundant apps, or unnecessary complexity.
Laura-ann Burgess
[SETAPP]
Mounting my cloud drives as if it was an external drive?! This app works incredibly well. Matter of
facts, it works better than any first party apps I’ve used. It also reduce the bloatware. It’s
incredibly handy, simple and powerful.
Nicolas Giuristante
[AppStore]
I've been using this app for a few years now. It was sluggish and would frequently loose connection.
But I stuck with it because it made sense with the type of work I do for my clients.
After the recent updates, the performance has gone through the roof! I get tasks done instantly and
efficently. I would like to thank the development team for a fantastic job well done!
Lilobell
[SETAPP]
CloudMounter gets used EVERYDAY! I primarily use it to connect to my Dropbox and Amazon S3 accounts,
and it seamlessly integrates them into my Mac as local drives.
Paul Taubman

## The Threat Stakes are High

### Why choose Sovereignty and why now is the right time?
1. #### Policy Mandate
   
   MeitY's Cloud Selection Framework has made sovereign cloud non-negotiable for critical government
   workloads.
   
   ESDS meets every MeitY empanelment compliance & standard.
2. #### Geopolitical Risk
   
   Geopolitical escalations can switch off cloud access overnight.
   
   Our sovereign infrastructure keeps your critical infra safe.
3. #### Data Security
   
   Cyber breaches result in losses of $4.88 million per incident globally.
   
   Our sovereign security solutions safeguard your most critical data.
4. #### Pricing Sovereignty
   
   USD-denominated billing brings risk that compounds with currency fluctuations.
   
   We price in INR, eliminating exposure to exchange-rate volatility.
5. #### The DPDP Act
   
   The DPDP Act is live. Non-compliance carries fines of up to ₹250 crore.
   
   ESDS is designed to meet the DPDP Act requirement.

## One intelligent platform. Complete technology control.

The visibility, control, and governance you need to optimize spend, reduce risk, and drive business
results. Traditional silos between IT management, SaaS management and Financial Operations are
disappearing. AI is an accelerant. Every team needs the same trusted view to manage it.

## Flexera One creates a shared knowledge layer

It centralizes all technology and business data in one clean, standardized view and then enriches it
with your business context including spend, contracts, adoption and risk.

## The Flexera One platform provides solutions for every major technology management discipline
## including:
## AI, FinOps, SaaS and IT Asset Management.

Flexera One AI Cost Management

## Full visibility of the AI technology stack

AI is the fastest-growing spend line item in your tech budget, and the hardest to see. Flexera One
gives you a complete view of every model, agent, token, and API call across your business, with the
cost and usage data to back it up. Know what your AI is doing, what it's costing and where to invest
next.

[ View our solutions ][98]
[AI model spend by service]
[Flexera One FinOps]

Flexera One FinOps

## Autonomous cloud cost optimization

Cloud spend moves faster than any team can manually manage. Flexera One automates the work,
surfacing waste, flagging anomalies, and recommending optimizations across every cloud provider. Ask
your cloud anything and get answers in seconds, not spreadsheets, so your FinOps team can focus on
strategy instead of cost reports.

[ View our solutions ][99]

Flexera One SaaS Management

## See every SaaS app, seat and dollar spent

Most enterprises pay for two to three times more SaaS than they use. Flexera One finds every app,
including the ones no one told IT about, and shows you exactly who’s using what. Reclaim unused
seats, renegotiate with evidence, and shut down shadow SaaS before the next renewal cycle.

[ View our solutions ][100]
[Flexera One SaaS Management]
[Hybrid FinOps: Executive Summary]

Flexera One IT Asset Management

## Compliance and audits answered with a simple AI chat

Audits, renewals, and license decisions used to take weeks. Now they take a question. With a natural
language interface, Flexera One lets you ask your IT estate anything and get instant answers backed
by clean, normalized data. Withstand every audit, gain leverage at every negotiation, and turn ITAM
from a back-office function into a strategic advantage.

[ View our solutions ][101]

## Flexera Knowledge Layer: Contextual, canonical, complete.

Flexera grounds our knowledge layer in a real-time view of your technology assets and data and
enriches that view with Flexera’s our proprietary data-catalog, Technopedia.

From AI agents and models to SaaS, cloud, software, and hardware, this provides a foundation of
trusted data that every team, every decision and every Flexera module is built on.

[ See how it works ][102]

## Trusted by Organizations Building the Future of AI

## One Platform

### *Five Ways to Put Your Data to Work*

Others create new silos. **We unify the ones you already have.**

AI Data Platform

## The Simplest Path to AI Data Readiness

Fragmented data is the critical barrier to enterprise AI. Hammerspace solves it differently, from
disconnected silos to a connected, powerful AI data pipeline.

[AI Data Platform][149]
* ### Unify. Don't Centralize.
  
  Centralizing AI data is the enemy of an agile strategy. Instantly catalog unstructured data across
  any silo using data-in-place assimilation — eliminating the heavy overhead of copy-first pipelines
  that stall AI initiatives.
* ### Automate Global Data Orchestration.
  
  Free your data engineers from manual infrastructure logistics. Objective-based policies
  dynamically move data to the right compute location without changing user access or disrupting
  application file paths.
* ### Accelerate AI Workflows.
  
  Collapse the time between data and insight. Hammerspace delivers data to GPU clusters, AI
  applications, and agents the moment they need it, without proprietary middleware.

Hammerspace Tier 0 Architecture

## Use Server-local NVMe as a Shared High-Performance Tier

Hammerspace Tier 0 architecture transforms server-local NVMe into a shared high-performance storage
tier, activating flash capacity already deployed across the compute cluster as part of the
Hammerspace Data Platform. 

4.4x
Higher Throughput
56%
Lower Latency
66%
Faster Checkpointing
* Delivers shared access to server-local NVMe across the cluster
* Automated data orchestration between Tier 0 and capacity tiers
* No client or agent to install on the compute nodes
Avoid network bottlenecks.
Increase GPU utilization.
Complete checkpoints faster.
Improve response times for inferencing and agentic AI.
[Discover Tier 0][150]

Hybrid Environments

## True Multi-Cloud Freedom for Distributed Enterprises

Your workloads shouldn’t be hostage to where your data lives. Hammerspace makes your data a single
pool of resources, available anywhere. Shift workloads among your own data centers, or move them to
AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI without bulk data migration. 
* **Reduced Cloud Egress Costs:** Data only moves when required or by automated policies, reducing
  costs.
* **Global Collaboration:** Connect distributed teams through a single, consistent file system
  across any location or cloud.
* **Objective-Based Mobility:** Automate non-disruptive data placement to the right storage tier.

[Hybrid Cloud Capabilities][151]

Hammerspace Infrastructure

## Built by the Architects of Modern Infrastructure

We don’t just build AI infrastructure.
We built the foundations it runs on.

Hammerspace is led by the world’s foremost minds in Linux, storage, and AI data systems — not
consultants, not second-generation startups, but the creators of the standards and technologies
everyone else depends on. At the core of our engineering team are individuals who shaped the very
fabric of today’s data infrastructure:

### David Flynn

The original architect whose vision became NVMe, and the inventor behind the modern flash storage
revolution.

### Mike Bloom

The AI architect behind data systems for LLM builders, neoclouds, and GenAI enterprise strategies.

### Trond Myklebust

The principal Linux NFS maintainer, and a driving force in the Linux kernel for over two decades.

### Mike Snitzer

Core Contributor to the Linux storage stack. If it runs block storage, it runs his code.

### Brian Pawlowski

The co-architect of NFSv3 at Sun and the NetApp CTO who helped define enterprise NAS as we know it. 

### Tom Haynes

The co-author of the NFSv4.2 protocol, the standard everyone else implements.

## Every AI Initiative Starts With Better Data

### The 2026 Enterprise SSD Crisis Survival Guide

Enterprise SSD prices have surged 200% and lead times now exceed 5 months. Don't let supply chain
bottlenecks stall your modernization or AI initiatives.
[Download the Guide][153]

### The Hammerspace Data Platform Architecture

Traditional, storage-centric architectures lock unstructured data into fragmented silos across sites
and clouds. Read the comprehensive architectural breakdown of how Hammerspace separates file
metadata from data to create a single parallel global file system—unifying access and automating
data mobility without disruptive migrations.
[Read the Whitepaper][154]

### Validated Performance: IO500 Benchmark Results

High performance without efficiency creates additional complexity and higher costs. See why recent

# The Data Platform for AI Anywhere

Unify, Orchestrate, and Accelerate Unstructured Data for Distributed AI and HPC Workflows.
*Any Storage. Any Cloud. Anywhere.*
[Get a Live Demo][148]
* Eliminate Data Silos.
* Overcome Data Gravity.
* Enable Hybrid-Cloud Agility.
* Improve Team Productivity.
* Modernize Infrastructure for AI.
* Simplify Data Governance.
* Accelerate AI-Readiness.
* Maximize GPU Utilization.
* Utilize Existing Infrastructure.
* Eliminate Vendor Lock-in.
* Streamline Global Collaboration.
* Make Unstructured Data AI-Ready.
* Automate Data Management.

## Trusted by Organizations Building the Future of AI

## One Platform

### *Five Ways to Put Your Data to Work*

Others create new silos. **We unify the ones you already have.**

AI Data Platform

## The Simplest Path to AI Data Readiness

Fragmented data is the critical barrier to enterprise AI. Hammerspace solves it differently, from
disconnected silos to a connected, powerful AI data pipeline.

[AI Data Platform][149]
* ### Unify. Don't Centralize.
  
  Centralizing AI data is the enemy of an agile strategy. Instantly catalog unstructured data across
  any silo using data-in-place assimilation — eliminating the heavy overhead of copy-first pipelines
  that stall AI initiatives.
* ### Automate Global Data Orchestration.
  
  Free your data engineers from manual infrastructure logistics. Objective-based policies
  dynamically move data to the right compute location without changing user access or disrupting
  application file paths.
* ### Accelerate AI Workflows.
  
  Collapse the time between data and insight. Hammerspace delivers data to GPU clusters, AI
  applications, and agents the moment they need it, without proprietary middleware.

Hammerspace Tier 0 Architecture

## Use Server-local NVMe as a Shared High-Performance Tier

Hammerspace Tier 0 architecture transforms server-local NVMe into a shared high-performance storage
tier, activating flash capacity already deployed across the compute cluster as part of the
Hammerspace Data Platform. 

4.4x
Higher Throughput
56%
Lower Latency
66%
Faster Checkpointing
* Delivers shared access to server-local NVMe across the cluster
* Automated data orchestration between Tier 0 and capacity tiers
* No client or agent to install on the compute nodes
Avoid network bottlenecks.
Increase GPU utilization.
Complete checkpoints faster.
Improve response times for inferencing and agentic AI.
[Discover Tier 0][150]

Hybrid Environments

## True Multi-Cloud Freedom for Distributed Enterprises

Your workloads shouldn’t be hostage to where your data lives. Hammerspace makes your data a single
pool of resources, available anywhere. Shift workloads among your own data centers, or move them to
AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI without bulk data migration. 
* **Reduced Cloud Egress Costs:** Data only moves when required or by automated policies, reducing
  costs.
* **Global Collaboration:** Connect distributed teams through a single, consistent file system
  across any location or cloud.
* **Objective-Based Mobility:** Automate non-disruptive data placement to the right storage tier.

[Hybrid Cloud Capabilities][151]
Hammerspace Global Namespace

Customer Story

### Vanderbilt ACCRE reduced storage costs by 48% without replacing a single storage system.

Advanced Computing Center for Research & Education
[Read the Case Study][152]

Hammerspace Infrastructure

## Built by the Architects of Modern Infrastructure

We don’t just build AI infrastructure.
We built the foundations it runs on.

Hammerspace is led by the world’s foremost minds in Linux, storage, and AI data systems — not
consultants, not second-generation startups, but the creators of the standards and technologies
everyone else depends on. At the core of our engineering team are individuals who shaped the very
fabric of today’s data infrastructure:

### David Flynn

The original architect whose vision became NVMe, and the inventor behind the modern flash storage
revolution.

### Mike Bloom

The AI architect behind data systems for LLM builders, neoclouds, and GenAI enterprise strategies.

### Trond Myklebust

The principal Linux NFS maintainer, and a driving force in the Linux kernel for over two decades.

### Mike Snitzer

Core Contributor to the Linux storage stack. If it runs block storage, it runs his code.

### Brian Pawlowski

The co-architect of NFSv3 at Sun and the NetApp CTO who helped define enterprise NAS as we know it. 

### Tom Haynes

The co-author of the NFSv4.2 protocol, the standard everyone else implements.

## Every AI Initiative Starts With Better Data

### The 2026 Enterprise SSD Crisis Survival Guide

Enterprise SSD prices have surged 200% and lead times now exceed 5 months. Don't let supply chain
bottlenecks stall your modernization or AI initiatives.
[Download the Guide][153]

### The Hammerspace Data Platform Architecture

Traditional, storage-centric architectures lock unstructured data into fragmented silos across sites
and clouds. Read the comprehensive architectural breakdown of how Hammerspace separates file
metadata from data to create a single parallel global file system—unifying access and automating
data mobility without disruptive migrations.
[Read the Whitepaper][154]

### Validated Performance: IO500 Benchmark Results

High performance without efficiency creates additional complexity and higher costs. See why recent
IO500 benchmark results demonstrate how Hammerspace delivers 2x the HPC-class AI performance with
less than 50% of the infrastructure.
[View the Benchmark Results][155]

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

Bring control to cost, data, and operations across your AI environment.

Drive Unified Governance and Cost Control for Agentic AI

## One Platform.
## One Experience.
## Run Anywhere.

The Nutanix platform powers AI‑era innovation, container‑based modernization, and better business
outcomes.

### Innovate Faster

Build, optimize, and govern enterprise‑ready AI factories for the agentic AI era with greater
efficiency, performance, and sovereignty.

### Modernize Now

Modernize AI and cloud native workloads with containers and Kubernetes built in, running VMs and
containers on one platform for maximum flexibility and control.

### Run Better

Operate apps and manage data anywhere by unifying on‑premises, cloud, and edge environments to
reduce complexity and deliver predictable operations.

#### Take Control of Your Cloud Environment

# Stop Going Over Budget and Boost Your Cloud Performance

Your HPC experience is influenced by cost, security, performance, and design choices. With NZO, you
have the power to manage them all.

[ Get a Demo ][30]

## **Organizations That Trust NZO Cloud**

## **What Good Are Unlimited Resources When You’re Always Over Budget?**

Unlimited resources are great, but they’re way too expensive. **Managing cloud spend continues to be
a problem for organizations.**

15

**15%** of organizations go over budget on cloud spend

31

**31%** Expect their cloud spend to increase over the next year

27

**27%** of organizations estimate that they have wasted cloud spend in IaaS and PaaS

## **NZO Cloud Provides the Solution**

NZO Cloud solves this problem by offering a single, fixed price. No surprise charges, data transfer
fees, or extra licensing costs. With NZO Cloud, you can use all the computing and storage resources
without worrying about your budget.

## **Cost**

No more surprise charges, data transfer fees, or extra licensing costs. Our straightforward
subscription pricing gives you peace of mind and nearly triples the cloud resources within your
budget.

[Learn More][31]

## **Design**

Every organization has unique cloud needs. Why settle for resources designed for someone else? Our
NZO engineers collaborate with you to create the perfect cloud computing and storage solutions
tailored to your specific application needs, business demands, and budget.

[Learn More][32]

## **Performance**

Consistent, reliable, high-performance cloud services can transform your organization. With NZO,
there's no more waiting in job queues, virtualization, sharing resources, or blackouts or brownouts.

[Learn More][33]

## **Security**

NZO is dedicated to the highest levels of compliance and security. We use advanced security
protocols to protect your critical data and strictly adhere to HIPAA, ITAR, ISO27001, and FISMA
standards.

[Learn More][34]

## **Navigating the AI-Cloud Computing Landscape: Trends and Applications**

Leveraging cloud-based AI services and an HPC cloud environment helps organizations speed up
application development and deployment, cut infrastructure costs, and scale operations efficiently.
Discover where AI is headed in the future, and which trends are shaping its evolution.

[Get Free Report][35]

## **Different Industries and Teams Need Different Cloud Solutions**

Support your team, enhance cloud control and performance, and get tailored solutions for your
industry. We don't expect you to fit into a box for your cloud environment, and you shouldn't have
to.

### **AI**

Partnering with NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Xylinx, NZO offers the most technically capable AI cloud
environment, ready to run your largest training models.
[Learn More][36]

### **Engineering**

We offer exclusive 100% dedicated instances, ensuring seamless and uninterrupted execution of your
computing jobs.
[Learn More][37]

### **Higher Education**

Our cutting-edge platforms enable research institutions to tackle even the most complex and
data-intensive simulations while delivering advanced analytics that drive groundbreaking
discoveries.
[Learn More][38]

### **Federal Government**

We take tremendous pride in our 25+ year history working with the Department of Defense, Department
of Energy, National Institutes of Health, National Oceanic.
[Learn More][39]

### **Life Sciences**

NZO offers a game-changing cloud solution that enables life science and healthcare organizations to
accelerate research, enhance patient outcomes, fortify data security, and optimize operational
efficiency.
[Learn More][40]

### **Weather Modeling**

Accessing a powerful, scalable, and reliable high-performance cloud computing environment engineered
to assist meteorologists in staying one step ahead of weather events.
[Learn More][41]

## **Discover Cloud Success Stories With NZO**

“My large weather models require dedicated, AI and HPC compute and storage. With millions of
calculations done across a territory and in parallel with other territories I must have control of
my performance, cost and security. Collaborating with NZO allows me to develop a fully optimized,
always on demand, budget friendly, AI enabled HPC clouds tailored to my needs.”

##### Scott Capps

###### Principal Scientist

#### Take Control of Your Cloud Environment

# Stop Going Over Budget and Boost Your Cloud Performance

Your HPC experience is influenced by cost, security, performance, and design choices. With NZO, you
have the power to manage them all.

[ Get a Demo ][30]

## **Organizations That Trust NZO Cloud**

## **What Good Are Unlimited Resources When You’re Always Over Budget?**

Unlimited resources are great, but they’re way too expensive. **Managing cloud spend continues to be
a problem for organizations.**

15

**15%** of organizations go over budget on cloud spend

31

**31%** Expect their cloud spend to increase over the next year

27

**27%** of organizations estimate that they have wasted cloud spend in IaaS and PaaS

## **NZO Cloud Provides the Solution**

NZO Cloud solves this problem by offering a single, fixed price. No surprise charges, data transfer
fees, or extra licensing costs. With NZO Cloud, you can use all the computing and storage resources
without worrying about your budget.

## **Cost**

No more surprise charges, data transfer fees, or extra licensing costs. Our straightforward
subscription pricing gives you peace of mind and nearly triples the cloud resources within your
budget.

[Learn More][31]

## **Design**

Every organization has unique cloud needs. Why settle for resources designed for someone else? Our
NZO engineers collaborate with you to create the perfect cloud computing and storage solutions
tailored to your specific application needs, business demands, and budget.

[Learn More][32]

## **Performance**

Consistent, reliable, high-performance cloud services can transform your organization. With NZO,
there's no more waiting in job queues, virtualization, sharing resources, or blackouts or brownouts.

[Learn More][33]

## **Security**

NZO is dedicated to the highest levels of compliance and security. We use advanced security
protocols to protect your critical data and strictly adhere to HIPAA, ITAR, ISO27001, and FISMA
standards.

[Learn More][34]

## **Navigating the AI-Cloud Computing Landscape: Trends and Applications**

Leveraging cloud-based AI services and an HPC cloud environment helps organizations speed up
application development and deployment, cut infrastructure costs, and scale operations efficiently.
Discover where AI is headed in the future, and which trends are shaping its evolution.

[Get Free Report][35]

## **Different Industries and Teams Need Different Cloud Solutions**

Support your team, enhance cloud control and performance, and get tailored solutions for your
industry. We don't expect you to fit into a box for your cloud environment, and you shouldn't have
to.

### **AI**

Partnering with NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Xylinx, NZO offers the most technically capable AI cloud
environment, ready to run your largest training models.
[Learn More][36]

### **Engineering**

We offer exclusive 100% dedicated instances, ensuring seamless and uninterrupted execution of your
computing jobs.
[Learn More][37]

### **Higher Education**

Our cutting-edge platforms enable research institutions to tackle even the most complex and
data-intensive simulations while delivering advanced analytics that drive groundbreaking
discoveries.
[Learn More][38]

### **Federal Government**

We take tremendous pride in our 25+ year history working with the Department of Defense, Department
of Energy, National Institutes of Health, National Oceanic.
[Learn More][39]

### **Life Sciences**

NZO offers a game-changing cloud solution that enables life science and healthcare organizations to
accelerate research, enhance patient outcomes, fortify data security, and optimize operational
efficiency.
[Learn More][40]

### **Weather Modeling**

Accessing a powerful, scalable, and reliable high-performance cloud computing environment engineered
to assist meteorologists in staying one step ahead of weather events.
[Learn More][41]

## **Discover Cloud Success Stories With NZO**

“My large weather models require dedicated, AI and HPC compute and storage. With millions of
calculations done across a territory and in parallel with other territories I must have control of
my performance, cost and security. Collaborating with NZO allows me to develop a fully optimized,
always on demand, budget friendly, AI enabled HPC clouds tailored to my needs.”

##### Scott Capps

###### Principal Scientist

## What Services Does Opsio Provide?

End-to-end managed services tailored to your business needs — from infrastructure operations to AI
implementation.

### Managed Infrastructure Services

Opsio provides round-the-clock monitoring, optimization, and management of your infrastructure
across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Our dedicated teams handle patching, incident response, and
capacity planning so your engineers can focus on building products instead of maintaining servers.
Clients typically see a 40% reduction in unplanned downtime within the first quarter.

[Explore Managed Infrastructure Services →][22]

### Migration & Modernization

We help businesses move workloads to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud with minimal downtime and zero data
loss. Our structured approach covers assessment, 6R strategy selection, wave planning, and
post-migration optimization. With over 2,000 workloads migrated, we deliver transitions that are
faster and less disruptive than industry averages.

[Explore Migration & Modernization →][23]

### DevOps & Automation

Opsio builds CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, and GitOps workflows that
accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining governance. We implement Terraform modules,
Kubernetes deployment strategies, and automated testing pipelines tailored to your team.
Organizations we work with typically see a 3-5x increase in deployment frequency.

[Explore DevOps & Automation →][24]

### Security & Compliance

We build zero-trust architectures with identity governance, SIEM/SOC integration, and continuous
compliance monitoring. Our team helps organizations meet ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, and HIPAA
requirements through automated policy enforcement and audit-ready configurations. We design
compliant systems from day one rather than retrofitting after deployment.

[Explore Security & Compliance →][25]

### Data & AI

From MLOps platforms and predictive maintenance to computer vision and intelligent document
processing, Opsio delivers enterprise AI solutions tailored to specific business problems. We build
RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration layers, and data lake architectures that turn raw data into
actionable intelligence. Recent projects have reduced manual review time by 70% for our clients.

[Explore Data & AI →][26]

### Shield

Proactive threat detection, penetration testing, load testing, and social engineering assessments to
protect your business from evolving threats. Our Shield program provides end-to-end security
operations including vulnerability scanning, red team exercises, and continuous monitoring. We
identify risks before attackers do and help you build resilient defenses.

Opsio is a managed services provider headquartered in Karlstad, Sweden, with a delivery center in
Bangalore, India. Founded in 2022, Opsio provides 24/7 managed infrastructure across [Amazon Web
Services][17], [Microsoft Azure][18], and [Google Cloud Platform][19]. The company holds AWS
Advanced Partner status and employs over 50 certified professionals who have completed more than
3,000 projects across Europe and Asia. Core services include infrastructure management, migration,
DevOps automation, security and [ISO 27001][20]/[NIST][21] compliance, FinOps cost optimization, and
enterprise AI implementation. Clients typically achieve 30-40% reduction in infrastructure spending
through Opsio's FinOps practices.

## What Services Does Opsio Provide?

End-to-end managed services tailored to your business needs — from infrastructure operations to AI
implementation.

### Managed Infrastructure Services

Opsio provides round-the-clock monitoring, optimization, and management of your infrastructure
across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Our dedicated teams handle patching, incident response, and
capacity planning so your engineers can focus on building products instead of maintaining servers.
Clients typically see a 40% reduction in unplanned downtime within the first quarter.

[Explore Managed Infrastructure Services →][22]

### Migration & Modernization

We help businesses move workloads to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud with minimal downtime and zero data
loss. Our structured approach covers assessment, 6R strategy selection, wave planning, and
post-migration optimization. With over 2,000 workloads migrated, we deliver transitions that are
faster and less disruptive than industry averages.

[Explore Migration & Modernization →][23]

### DevOps & Automation

Opsio builds CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, and GitOps workflows that
accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining governance. We implement Terraform modules,
Kubernetes deployment strategies, and automated testing pipelines tailored to your team.
Organizations we work with typically see a 3-5x increase in deployment frequency.

[Explore DevOps & Automation →][24]

### Security & Compliance

We build zero-trust architectures with identity governance, SIEM/SOC integration, and continuous
compliance monitoring. Our team helps organizations meet ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, and HIPAA
requirements through automated policy enforcement and audit-ready configurations. We design
compliant systems from day one rather than retrofitting after deployment.

[Explore Security & Compliance →][25]

### Data & AI

From MLOps platforms and predictive maintenance to computer vision and intelligent document
processing, Opsio delivers enterprise AI solutions tailored to specific business problems. We build
RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration layers, and data lake architectures that turn raw data into
actionable intelligence. Recent projects have reduced manual review time by 70% for our clients.

[Explore Data & AI →][26]

### Shield

Proactive threat detection, penetration testing, load testing, and social engineering assessments to
protect your business from evolving threats. Our Shield program provides end-to-end security
operations including vulnerability scanning, red team exercises, and continuous monitoring. We
identify risks before attackers do and help you build resilient defenses.

[Explore Shield →][27]

Owler's exclusive company and industry insights make it easy to find competitors, leads, and
up-to-date news – so you can optimize your prospecting and sales results.

## For business professionals who want a serious competitive advantage

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

**Get the latest news updates to stay ahead**

[ Learn about Owler Pro ][63]

Account Executive

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

# Strategic intelligence and grounded context
# for marketing teamsstrategy teams
# and AI Agents.

Polaris7 maps the companies, technologies, and strategic movements shaping digital advertising,
marketing technology, and digital platforms. While raw AI search hallucinates names and misses
connections, our vertical knowledge graph provides the grounded entity resolution and context you
need to make decisions with confidence. Modern AI agents require precise, structured context to
perform research without hallucinating—which is exactly what our graph feeds them.

[Get Started for Free][4][How it works][5]

Polaris7 does not aim to list every company in the world. It focuses on the companies, capabilities
and relationships that matter inside complex digital ecosystems.

## Digital advertising, AdTech, MarTech, and digital platforms are too complex for current market
## intelligence tools.

The ecosystems behind digital platforms change constantly: vendors reposition, categories blur, and
critical signals are scattered across news, websites, and code. Traditional search and raw AI agents
cannot navigate this complexity without structure.

### Signal vs Noise

Raw AI search returns unstructured PR statements and SEO spam. Polaris7 structures actual strategic
shifts, partnerships, and product launches to isolate what matters.

### No Flat Databases

Generic databases only list records. Polaris7 maps parent-child structures, competitors, and
programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

### Real-Time Updates

Static PDF reports are obsolete before they are printed. Our knowledge graph daily detects strategic
shifts as they unfold across the web.

### Grounded Graph

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

## Markets are systems, not lists.

Markets are not flat directories of companies. They are systems of roles, capabilities,
relationships, competition and strategic movement.

Polaris7 maps complex digital ecosystems—including digital advertising, marketing technology, and
digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the
right context.

Polaris7 transforms fragmented digital market complexity into structured, actionable intelligence
built for your specific workflow.

## intelligence tools.

The ecosystems behind digital platforms change constantly: vendors reposition, categories blur, and
critical signals are scattered across news, websites, and code. Traditional search and raw AI agents
cannot navigate this complexity without structure.

Raw AI search returns unstructured PR statements and SEO spam. Polaris7 structures actual strategic
shifts, partnerships, and product launches to isolate what matters.

Generic databases only list records. Polaris7 maps parent-child structures, competitors, and
programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

### Real-Time Updates

Static PDF reports are obsolete before they are printed. Our knowledge graph daily detects strategic
shifts as they unfold across the web.

### Grounded Graph

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

## Markets are systems, not lists.

Markets are not flat directories of companies. They are systems of roles, capabilities,
relationships, competition and strategic movement.

Polaris7 maps complex digital ecosystems—including digital advertising, marketing technology, and
digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the
right context.

## Agentic intelligence for strategic decisions.

Turn fragmented market movements into resolved, structured deliverables in minutes. Polaris7 agents

Deliverable 01

#### Acquisition Target Lists

Identify target companies based on capability gaps, category overlaps, and strategic positioning.

#### Competitor Analyses

Create detailed tear-downs mapping vendor capabilities, integration structures, and market overlap.

Deliverable 03

#### Partner Shortlists

Deliverable 04

#### Category Maps

Build complete taxonomical maps of blurred digital market sectors for new entry planning.

## Go beyond data: understand strategy

Polaris7 does not just show companies and competitors.

It helps you understand:

### Positioning

Understand exactly how companies are positioned within the market landscape.

### Capabilities

Map out the products, infrastructure, and technology they actually provide.

### Competition

See who they compete against, where they overlap, and who leads.

### Strategic Movement

Track M&A, partnerships, and market signals to see where the market is going.

### Built by industry experts, validated by data

Complex digital ecosystems are too nuanced for generic AI to parse accurately without structural
constraints. Polaris7 combines deep domain expertise in advertising, media, and digital platforms
with expert-grounded AI to provide strategic intelligence that actually understands industry
mechanics.

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw Google results. They confuse parent holdings with
operating subsidiaries and miss critical partner integrations. Polaris7 agents operate on a
resolved, curated knowledge graph, delivering answers grounded in verified, real-world
relationships.

Developers ship code faster than ever, especially with AI. It’s impossible to keep up when every
infrastructure request is forced through the same heavyweight process.

You can’t keep up with developer experimentation and rapid prototyping.

[lock icon]

Non-critical requests clog your production change queue.

Your team gains a reputation as a bottleneck instead of an enabler.

## A modern approach to infrastructure management

* Non-critical requests deployed with natural language
* Standardized workflows instead of scattered scripts and pipelines
* More time for strategic platform work, less time on one-off changes

[security icon]

* Policies enforced as code across both paths
* Live view of what is running, where, and who changed it
* Drift detection and remediation instead of surprise changes in production

## Automation & Orchestration Built for Your Modern Enterprise

Finally, a single platform of IT automation solutions that are event-based, respond intelligently to
business needs, minimize human oversight, and run on-prem and in the cloud.

### Workload Automation

+ −

Take an evolutionary leap beyond legacy job schedulers to centrally build, schedule and manage all
IT tasks and business processes across your hybrid environment with real-time, event-based triggers.

[ Learn More ][127]

### Cloud Automation

+ −

Master your hybrid IT environment. No longer are separate cloud job schedulers necessary. Centrally
manage end-to-end automation across private, public, and multi-cloud landscapes.

[ Learn More ][128]
[Icon Job Scheduling Hexagon]

### Job Scheduling

+ −

Enterprise job scheduling automates much of the backend work of a typical IT department, allowing
for higher quality maintenance and therefore a better performing system.

[ Learn More ][129]

### DevOps Automation

+ −

Stronger Together—Developers and IT Ops Teams Unite. Empower both with infrastructure as code, jobs
as code and integration of the siloed tools used along with the CI/CD toolchain.

[ Learn More ][130]

### Data Pipeline Orchestration

+ −

Centrally create and manage automated workflows that span end-to-end data pipelines. Apply DataOps
methodologies, gain observability, and empower end-users with self-service access.

[ Learn More ][131]

### Managed File Transfer

+ −

Control the real-time flow of your data pipeline between mainframe, distributed network, private
cloud, and public cloud environments. Plus, securely manage B2B file transfer with 3rd party
vendors.

[ Learn More ][132]

A service orchestration and automation platform (SOAP) built for today … and tomorrow.

environment.

Create and manage workflows across multiple applications both on-premises and in the cloud.

[Learn more][133]

### Self-Service Automation

Empower end users, developers, and business users with citizen automator capabilities.

[Learn more][134]

### Infrastructure and Service Automation

Manage both on-prem. and cloud-based compute, network, and storage resources.

[Learn more][135]

### Manage Data Pipelines

Automate file transfers and orchestrate the ingestion and processing of multiple data streams.

Enable advanced reporting, observability, and predictive capabilities in support of improving SLAs
